author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-10 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Fight with it if you will.
context_before: Everything said of Jesus Christ in scripture is said of you, for you are the dreamer, and the world is your dream pushed out.
context_after: Do as you like, but you will not awaken until the dream is finished. Then you will awaken to discover that you are its dreamer and creator. There is nothing but your wonderful human imagination! There is no other God. There is no other Jesus Christ. There is no other Lord. Your human imagination is the God of scripture. This I know from experience.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 10-10-1969 (1969-10-10).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-10 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then persuade yourself of the reality of your assumption.
context_before: Let us assume that this is a dream and everything is perfect. You are happy and content and all is right in your world.
context_after: Don’t do anything to make it so; just trust the dreamer in you to bring it to pass, for the power who assumed your desire is the Lord Jesus Christ, and all things are possible to him. Your assumption, though false in the sense that it is denied by your senses and reason, if persisted in will harden into fact in such a normal, natural way that you will think it would have happened anyway. That is the dream. When imagination fulfills itself so naturally, it is easy to question that your assumption had anything to do with it; but I tell you it could not have happened without your assumption, for your awareness is the one and only cause of the phenomena of your life.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 10-10-1969 (1969-10-10).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-10 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Everyone is dreaming his own dream.
context_before: Right now you are living in a fabulous world you created, filled with those who agreed to dream with you in concert.
context_after: One dreams he wants to change the world. They call him Hitler or Stalin and millions of people appear to be killed, but they do not die. Rather, they simply depart this section of time and move into another, not even knowing they departed. Others will come and dream their desire of change and create a world in their own image; yet I tell you the whole thing was done before the world began. You are seeing simply the unfoldment of a purposed end which, as God, we agreed upon before we began the adventure.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 10-10-1969 (1969-10-10).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-10 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then the dream you and I are dreaming began.
context_before: is world began as a grand orgasm of God, with only this tiny little spot called earth capable of cradling life for the great experiment to take place.
context_after: If you don’t think it is a dream, take some section of your life that seems beyond redemption and rearrange it in your mind’s eye. Make it as you would like it to be. Persuade yourself of its truth and wait, because its fulfillment has its own appointed hour. It ripens, it will flower. If it be long, then wait, for it is sure and it will not be late. It will come into your objective world to bear witness to the reality of your assumption. Then you, too, will know that the world is a dream and you are its dreamer, the Jesus Christ of the New Testament and the Jehovah of the Old.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 10-10-1969 (1969-10-10).
